thread:
talia_cs: Customer reported a behavior regression after we flipped a canary today. They say their prompt used to return a structured JSON, now it's returning freeform text. customer provided request_id=req_8a7b2c and example prompt + outputs below.
jake_engml: can you paste the sanitized prompt + exact outputs? also which model/version and region?
talia_cs: pasted below (sanitized). model header on their request: model=redwood-v2.1.0-canary, region=us-west-2. They say prod (redwood-v2.0.0) matched our evals.
customer_john: reproducer prompt (sanitized):
"""
SYSTEM: You are a JSON-only formatter. Always return valid JSON matching the schema.
USER: Convert this invoice into structured JSON with fields: invoice_id, total, items[].
INPUT: Invoice text: "Acme Corp invoice #4512 - total $1,240. Items: License - $1200, Tax - $40."
"""
Expected (what they used to get): {"invoice_id":"4512","total":1240,"items":[{"desc":"License","amount":1200},{"desc":"Tax","amount":40}]}
Observed (canary): "Invoice 4512 from Acme shows a total of $1,240. It looks like items include License ($1,200) and Tax ($40)."
this is reproducible for them ~8/10.
samuel_runtime: deploy-bot shows a canary rollout completed at 1802154200 for redwood-v2.1.0-canary -> partial traffic. I want request logs + model selection path for req_8a7b2c. talia_cs can you paste request id?
talia_cs: request_id=req_8a7b2c (already gave). They also included headers: x-redwood-canary:true, x-client:acme-invoice-parser, temp=0.0, top_p=0.95.
deploy-bot: Deployment event: canary rollout started 1802153600, traffic %: 15%. image: redwood/v2.1.0-canary (kernel=opt-attn-1, quant=fp16), canary flag=true.
jake_engml: quick hypothesis: system message handling changed between v2.0 and v2.1 (we tightened prompt-normalization for safety). Our internal evals use stable short-system messages; customer's prompt relies on long SYSTEM instruction 'JSON-only formatter'. Might be getting post-processed out. Can you share their raw request headers + body? Also run the customer's prompt locally against v2.1.0-canary with the same headers.
talia_cs: pasted raw body + headers in thread (sanitized). I'm running a repro in staging now.
(talia_cs posts a short command): curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "x-redwood-canary: true" -d '{"model":"redwood-v2.1.0-canary","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a JSON-only formatter..."},{"role":"user","content":"Convert this invoice..."}],"temperature":0.0}'
jake_engml: ran similar locally. Result: v2.0.0-prod returns JSON; v2.1.0-canary returns narrative text. I dumped token-level logits: looks like at step ~token 4 the model is switching to natural language tokens. Possibly a change in system-prompt concatenation ordering or EOS handling.
samuel_runtime: can we check kernel selection and quantization path? deploy-bot said quant=fp16 on canary; prod also fp16. However v2.1 picked opt-attn-1 kernel which has a small context truncation change (we changed prefix stitching). That could affect how long system messages are injected.
sophie_product: how many customers affected? severity? should we rollback the canary?
talia_cs: only reported by Acme so far (1 enterprise seat). They say it blocks downstream parsers, high severity for them. Requested rollback if no fix soon.
jake_engml: suggested next steps: 1) run the customer's prompt set through our eval harness with v2.1.0-canary (include their multi-line SYSTEM instr). 2) compare concatenated prompt tokens vs prod to check for missing separators. 3) if mismatch, hotfix to prompt concatenation order. I can open a regression issue.
talia_cs: ran quick eval with 50 customer prompts in staging harness, pass rate dropped from 98% -> 42% on structured-output tests. I uploaded logs to S3 (link omitted).
samuel_runtime: priority action: temporarily reduce canary traffic for affected pool and route Acme to prod until root cause confirmed. I'll open a traffic rule change. @sophie_product FYI.
sophie_product: please escalate to Severity 2, ping legal/comms if we need to notify customer. Also add to status page if rollback not possible within 2 hours.
jake_engml: I created ticket REDW-5421 "v2.1 canary: system prompt concatenation regression" and assigned to eng-ml + eng-runtime. Repro steps + diffs attached.
talia_cs: told customer we are rolling their traffic back to stable and investigating; they'll test again in ~30m. thanks everyone. :pray:
customer_john: appreciate the quick response, will report back after verifying.
jake_engml: quick note for root cause drill: our internal evals use sanitized prompts where system messages are single-line. Customer uses multi-line with explicit "SYSTEM: ..." markers. We should expand eval corpora to include multi-line system instructions and long literal markers.
samuel_runtime: also adding kernel selection logs to standard request trace for next deploy to catch this earlier.
sophie_product: thanks team — keep me updated in the ticket. we need playbook entry for canary-output-regressions.
talia_cs: closing loop when redwood ticket updated.
